senses.gloss: (b. h.) to stroke, smear; esp. to anoint; to install in office by anointing.
units: <cite ref="Keritot 5b:85">Ker. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>מושְׁחִין את המלכים כמין נזר וכ׳</he> in anointing kings you draw the figure of a crown with the oil on your finger &c., v. <cite ref="K00473"><he>כי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Keritot 5b:19">Ib.</cite> <he>אין מושחין מלך וכ׳</he> a king succeeding his father is not anointed; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M02822"><he>מָשׁוּחַ</he></cite>, pl. <he>מְשׁוּחִים</he>, <he>מְשׁוּחִין</he>. <he>כהן מ׳</he> a high priest installed with the ceremony of anointing, contrad. to <he>מרובה בגדים</he>, v. <cite ref="M02569"><he>מְרוּבֶּה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Horayot 3:4">Hor. III, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 1:9">Meg. I, 9</cite> <he>אין כין כהן מ׳ בשמן וכ׳</he> there is no difference between the anointed and the unanointed high priest except &c. Sifré Tsav, Par. 3, ch. V; a. fr., v. <cite ref="M02870"><he>מָשִׁיחַ</he></cite>.—<he>מְשׁוּחַ מלחמה</he> the priest anointed as the chaplain of the army.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 8:1">Pesik. R. s. 8</cite> <he>מ׳ מלחמה</he>, v. <cite ref="M02870"><he>מָשִׁיחַ</he></cite> end.
<cite ref="Horayot 11b:13">Ib. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>מלכי בית דוד מ׳ וכ׳</he> the kings of the house of David are anointed kings, those of Israel are not installed by anointment; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be anointed. Ib. יהוא לא נ׳ וכ׳ Jehu would not have been anointed but for the contest of Joram’s followers. Ib. וממנו היה נִמְשָׁח המשכן וכ׳ with that oil (prepared by Moses) were anointed the Tabernacle &c.; Y. Sot. VIII, 22ᶜ.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12">Num. R. s. 12</cite> <he>עד שנִמְשְׁחוּ כולם</he> until all the vessels were anointed; a. fr.
